title: Private Foundry Agent IaC — main.bicep Output Contract
description: JSON Schema describing the outputs main.bicep MUST emit. Consumed by azd (`azd env get-values`), by the postprovision validation hook, and by humans inspecting `azd show`. No secrets, no keys; only resource IDs, principal IDs, and the private gateway hostname.

agentResourceGroupName.description: Name of the agent regional resource group (region = first half of regionPair).

modelResourceGroupName.description: Name of the Sweden Central model resource group.

weFoundryAccountId.description: Resource ID of the agent-region Foundry / Cognitive Services account (W-I1 in data-model.md).

weFoundryProjectId.description: Resource ID of the agent-region Foundry project (W-I2).

weFoundryProjectEndpoint.description: Foundry project endpoint URL (private; resolved via WE private DNS). This is what the agent SDK targets.

agentProjectPrincipalId.description: System-assigned managed identity principal ID of the WE Foundry project (W-I2). The audience subject in APIM's `validate-azure-ad-token` policy is derived from this principal.

scFoundryAccountId.description: Resource ID of the SC model-side Foundry / Azure OpenAI account (C-I1).

apimServiceId.description: Resource ID of the APIM service in SC (X-1).

apimGatewayHostname.description: Private gateway hostname of the APIM service. Resolves to W-P5's private IP from inside the WE agent VNet via the `privatelink.azure-api.net` zone.

apimInboundPrivateEndpointId.description: Resource ID of the cross-region APIM inbound private endpoint (W-P5), located in the WE agent VNet's PE subnet.

apimPrincipalId.description: System-assigned managed identity principal ID of the APIM service (X-1). Used by `authentication-managed-identity` and granted `Cognitive Services OpenAI User` on the SC Foundry account (X-3).

privateDnsZoneIds.description: Resource IDs of the private DNS zones the solution either created or reused. Keyed by canonical zone name. Allows downstream tooling to verify zone ownership and A-record bindings.

we.description: Zones linked to the WE agent VNet.

sc.description: Zones linked to the SC VNet.

modelDeploymentNames.description: Echoes the deployment names created on the SC Foundry / Azure OpenAI account. The Foundry Azure API Management connection (X-5) lists these (static discovery) or APIM serves them (dynamic discovery).

agentVnetId.description: Resource ID of the agent VNet (W-N1). Optional output; convenient for cross-stack diagnostics.

scVnetId.description: Resource ID of the SC VNet (C-N1). Optional output.

logAnalyticsWorkspaceId.description: Echoes the input logAnalyticsWorkspaceId when set, empty string otherwise. Lets the postprovision audit confirm which workspace (if any) the diagnostic settings target.
